captions.detailed: A modern black air fryer featuring a vertical rectangular body with a front control panel and a pull-out drawer. The control panel includes a central digital display screen, four square program selection buttons, and a rotating selector knob below the screen. The lower half of the appliance houses a large basket drawer with a glass window and a sturdy horizontal handle containing a release button. The drawer slides out smoothly, the selector knob rotates continuously, and the buttons press inward.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a kitchen countertop air fryer with a vertical black body, a central control panel consisting of a display screen, four push buttons, and a rotating selector knob. Below the panel, design a pull-out basket drawer with a glass window, a front handle, and an integrated release button, ensuring the drawer slides out and all controls have realistic joint articulations.
captions.factory: Construct the main vertical body by defining a hollowed outer shell box with a front cutout cavity. Model the drawer assembly as a nested group consisting of an outer drawer shell, an inner food basket, a front glass window, and a horizontal handle. Add a small release button within the handle geometry. Create the control panel with a central display box, four separate push buttons, and a cylindrical selector knob. Define prismatic joint articulations for the drawer, the four program buttons, and the handle release button, and a continuous revolute joint for the selector knob.
